gpu_layers.description: Number of model layers to offload to GPU (llama.cpp --n-gpu-layers). 0 keeps the model on CPU (the DLC CPU image default); -1 offloads every layer (full GPU). llama.cpp-specific — vLLM/SGLang always run fully on GPU and expose no per-layer CPU/GPU split knob.

threads.description: CPU threads used for generation (llama.cpp --threads). The dominant latency lever on CPU instances (0 lets llama.cpp pick). llama.cpp-specific — the GPU-only engines have no CPU-thread knob.

flash_attn.description: Enable llama.cpp's Flash Attention kernel (--flash-attn). A llama.cpp build-level toggle exposed as an env flag; vLLM/SGLang use Flash Attention unconditionally and expose no equivalent on/off switch.
